metaDescription: Compare population, literacy, schools, budgets and the latest weather of any two live districts side by side, from official government data.
title: District comparison
description: Compare key numbers side by side for any two live districts.
noFigures_finance: No budget figures are available for both districts yet.
noFigures_weather: No weather readings are available for both districts yet.
notInCompare: {module} is not part of the side-by-side comparison yet. This page compares demographics, infrastructure, finance and weather.
linksBelow: The links at the bottom open {module} for each district.
legendNote: Figures from each district's pages on ForThePeople.in
tapHint: Tap the name of any row to learn what it means.
sheetHigherBetter: Here a higher number is better. The better value is shown in green and the other in red.
sheetNotJudged: Neither number is better or worse: it just shows how the two districts differ.
help_population: How many people live in the district, from the latest count we have.
help_area: How much land the district covers, in square kilometres.
help_density: How many people live on each square kilometre of land. A bigger number means a more crowded district.
help_literacy: Out of every 100 people aged 7 and above, how many can read and write.
help_sexRatio: How many women there are for every 1,000 men. 1,000 would mean equal numbers.
help_taluks: How many taluks (smaller areas inside the district) it is divided into.
help_villages: How many villages the district has on record.
help_projects: How many building projects (roads, buildings, water works and more) we track in the district.
help_schemes: How many government schemes we list for the district.
help_schools: How many schools we list in the district.
help_police: How many police stations we list in the district.
help_budget: How much money was set aside for the district in the latest financial year, in crores of rupees (1 crore is 1,00,00,000).
help_spent: How much of that money was actually spent, in crores of rupees.
help_utilisation: Out of every ₹100 set aside, how many rupees were spent.
help_temperature: The temperature at the latest weather reading, in degrees Celsius.
help_humidity: How much water is in the air at the latest reading. A bigger number feels more sticky.
help_rainfall: How much rain fell today, in millimetres.
popSame: {nameA} and {nameB} have about the same number of people: {popA} and {popB}.
popRatio: {big} has about {ratio} times as many people as {small}: {popBig} against {popSmall}.
ringsUnits: Each ring fills to its share of 100%
ringsLiteracySame: Both districts have the same literacy rate: {pct}%.
ringsBudget: {name} has used more of its budget: {hi}% against {lo}%.
ringsBudgetSame: Both districts have used the same share of their budget: {pct}%.
